class.name: WebTorrentLobbyDirectory
class.brief_description: Lists WebRTC rooms on WebTorrent trackers.
class.description: A host is listed while its session is the server of a WebRTC room and its [NetwServerInfo] is [constant NetwServerInfo.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC]. Joining a listed room goes through the WebRTC transport. Without this node nothing is listed or browsed, and a room is still joined by its code. A room signaled through a game's own [NetwWebRTCSignaler] is never listed. Rooms are searched in the [code]signaling_namespace[/code] of those same defaults, or in [member NetwSessionConfig.app_id] when it is empty.

members.member: The [code]ws://[/code] or [code]wss://[/code] tracker URLs to browse and announce on. Empty reads [code skip-lint]trackers[/code] from [method NetwConnection.defaults] for [code]WebRTCMultiplayerPeer[/code], then the public trackers.
